profile.name: Eman Raz
profile.tagline: Onchain Data Analyst since 2021 | Former Flipside Ambassador for Axelar
profile.bio: Top 20 Flipside analyst with ~700 onchain dashboards built. Now building interactive Streamlit dashboards for Web3 ecosystems. Explore my recent work below.

contact.title: Need a custom dashboard?
contact.text: Have a project and want a dashboard built around your protocol? Sitting on raw onchain data that deserves deep analysis? I turn raw data into clear, decision-ready insights, from tailored analytics dashboards to in-depth research for your ecosystem. Send me a message and let's talk.

support.title: Support my work
support.text: If you find my dashboards useful and would like to support what I do, a tip is always appreciated. Thank you! 💙
